page_title: BOU 1-0 FUL | Bournemouth v Fulham 14/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
90+4' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) has tested the patience of referee Michael Oliver and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+2' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but Kepa Arrizabalaga comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+1' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) fails to score from the rebound as the goalkeeper stops his effort from hitting the net.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Here is a change. Antoine Semenyo is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Julio Soler (Bournemouth).
89' Fulham fail to score from a corner as Kepa Arrizabalaga (Bournemouth) leaps to collect the ball.

88' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Raul Jimenez (Fulham). The ball is out of play. Fulham will have a chance to score from a corner.
86' The foul by Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Michael Oliver.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Willian (Fulham) replaces Sasa Lukic.
84' A quickly taken corner by Fulham.
84' Fulham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Fulham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
84' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fulham comes to nothing. The referee signals a corner kick to Fulham.
83' Fulham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
83' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
82' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.
81' Referee Michael Oliver makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
81' Lovely run from Evanilson (Bournemouth). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
78' The attendance is 11195.
77' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.

76' Tom Cairney (Fulham) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time shot towards goal from a promising distance, but Kepa Arrizabalaga denies him.

75' A flowing move ends with a great cross into the centre of the box, which Adama Traore (Fulham) latches onto but sends a wild header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
74' Kepa Arrizabalaga (Bournemouth) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
73' Kepa Arrizabalaga (Bournemouth) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
72' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is flagged for offside.
72' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 12:11.

70' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Kepa Arrizabalaga makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal.
69' Substitution. Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) replaces Andreas Pereira.
68' Michael Oliver shows the yellow card to Tom Cairney (Fulham) for a heavy challenge.
68' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
67' A corner kick by Fulham is thwarted by the well prepared Kepa Arrizabalaga (Bournemouth).

67' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the left side of the goal, but Kepa Arrizabalaga made a superb athletic save to deny him. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
66' Adama Traore (Fulham) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
65' That's the end of the game for Alex Scott, who is replaced by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth).
64' Adama Traore (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
63' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
63' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Bournemouth.

62' Evanilson (Bournemouth) plants a header from the edge of the box after a nice cross from the free kick. It lacks accuracy and the ball flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
61' A yellow card for a tackle by Antonee Robinson (Fulham). Michael Oliver doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
59' Tom Cairney (Fulham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sander Berge.
57' The referee signals a substitution. Adama Traore (Fulham) is brought on as a substitute for Ryan Sessegnon.
57' Rodrigo Muniz goes off the pitch and Raul Jimenez (Fulham) comes on.
56' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Kepa Arrizabalaga comes off his line to intercept.
55' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the left side of the net, but the effort is smothered by the keeper.

55' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
54' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
54' Evanilson (Bournemouth) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
53' Bournemouth control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
52' A pass by Sander Berge (Fulham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball has crossed the sideline. Bournemouth are taking a throw-in.
50' The game is interrupted now, Evanilson (Bournemouth) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
50' A pass by Alex Iwobi (Fulham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. It's a throw-in for Bournemouth.
48' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) tries to find Antonee Robinson, but he puts too much power on the pass.
48' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
47' Bournemouth are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
46' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) comes on the pitch for Marcos Senesi.
46' Referee Michael Oliver blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.

45+2' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score into the bottom right corner, but great anticipation by Bernd Leno allowed him to make a comfortable save. Bournemouth will take a corner kick.
45+1' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
44' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
43' A lofted cross from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
43' The referee awards a corner and Andreas Pereira (Fulham) goes over to take it.

43' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fulham.

42' Evanilson (Bournemouth) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
40' The Fulham players are exchanging some short passes.
38' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Bernd Leno comes off his line to intercept.
37' Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the right post. His effort, however, is blocked by Kepa Arrizabalaga, who pulls off a stunning save!
37' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
36' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
36' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender. Good work from Bournemouth as they win a corner.
35' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Bournemouth have a corner.
35' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bournemouth.
34' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) rises highest from the corner and heads at goal, but his effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Kepa Arrizabalaga.
34' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is about to take a corner kick.
33' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fulham.

33' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) was in a good shooting position inside the six-yard box and produced a first-time shot towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper made an astonishing save to thwart him.

32' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) skips around Kepa Arrizabalaga and has the goal at his mercy but unbelievably misses the empty net. Hold your head in shame son! The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
30' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
30' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) attempts to find Ryan Sessegnon, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
29' Poor challenge! Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) is penalised for tripping and Michael Oliver blows his whistle.
29' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
27' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
27' The resulting corner, taken by Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth), comes to nothing.

27' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Bournemouth force a corner. They send men into the box.
26' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) will take a corner kick.
26' Evanilson (Bournemouth) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
25' The referee blows his whistle as Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) was too aggressive in his challenge.
25' Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
25' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Michael Oliver blows his whistle for an infringement.
24' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
22' The Bournemouth players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

20' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the goal, but Kepa Arrizabalaga keeps it out.

20' Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Michael Oliver blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. There is a free kick near the sideline to Fulham.
18' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
17' OFF THE BAR! Evanilson (Bournemouth) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball crashes against the crossbar.
15' A pass by Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
14' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends a long ball forward to Ryan Sessegnon, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
13' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
13' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
12' A pass by Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
11' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
11' The ball is cleared after Evanilson (Bournemouth) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
10' Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) brings his opponent down. Michael Oliver has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Bournemouth.
10' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
8' A pass by Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
7' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Evanilson (Bournemouth) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
6' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Bernd Leno, who smothers the ball.
6' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
5' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
4' Neat passing move from Bournemouth in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' 1 - 0 Goal! Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
